name: zcode-codex-leader
description: Force ZCode into leader-only mode. Hard PreToolUse gate blocks direct edits and commands; all code generation, visual understanding, image generation, and MCP tool work is dispatched to a resident codex app-server worker via codex_bridge.ts. SessionStart injects the leader constitution and starts the worker; Stop enforces Plugin evidence.

codex_binary.description: Optional: path to the codex binary. Defaults to ~/.hermes/node/bin/codex, then PATH.
